columns.name: PK1_VALUE

columns.description: Primary key value of the node.

columns.description: Primary key value of the node.

columns.description: ID of the tree node that is the ancestor of this node. If this value is null, this node is the root node of the tree.

columns.name: ANCESTOR_DATA_SOURCE_ID
columns.description: Ancestor data source Id

columns.name: ANCESTOR_PK1_VALUE
columns.description: Primary key value of the ancestor node.

columns.description: Primary key value of the ancestor node.

columns.description: Primary key value of the ancestor node.

columns.name: ANCESTOR_TREE_LABEL_ID
columns.description: Tree label of the ancestor node.Foreign key to FND_TREE_LABEL.

columns.name: DISTANCE
columns.description: Distance between the Node and its Ancestor.

columns.name: IS_LEAF
columns.description: Flag to indicate if this Node is a Leaf Node.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
